Agent Name: Engineer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Engineer implemented a flawed algorithm for finding overlapping meetings. The solution has O(n^2) time complexity due to the nested loop structure, which violates the O(n log n) constraint specified in the task. The algorithm sorts meetings by start time but then iterates through all subsequent meetings for each meeting to check for overlaps, resulting in quadratic time complexity. The correct approach should use a sweep-line algorithm or sort by start time and maintain a running maximum end time to achieve O(n log n) complexity. Additionally, the current implementation only adds the conflicting meeting to the result list but doesn't properly handle the case where a meeting might conflict with multiple other meetings (it would be added multiple times if not deduplicated, though the current logic avoids this by only checking forward). The fundamental error is the algorithmic complexity mismatch with the stated requirements.
